name: New Relic One
overview: Monitor LaunchDarkly flag events in New Relic One.
description: This integration sends LaunchDarkly flag changes to New Relic One as feature flag [change tracking events](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/change-tracking/change-tracking-introduction/) using the NerdGraph API.
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: New Relic user API key
formVariables.description: Enter your [New Relic user API key](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/apis/intro-apis/new-relic-api-keys/#user-key). User API keys start with `NRAK-`. REST API keys are not supported.

formVariables.name: New Relic application ID
formVariables.description: Enter your [New Relic APM application ID](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/apis/rest-api-v2/get-started/get-app-other-ids-new-relic-one/). Change tracking events are recorded on this APM entity.

formVariables.name: Data Center
formVariables.description: Your New Relic data center. This sets the NerdGraph API host. The default (US) is "api.newrelic.com". Use "api.eu.newrelic.com" if you are using the EU data center.
